highlights.title: Instant Latest Release Installation
highlights.description: PWA installation automatically syncs and launches the latest build without being delayed by stale service worker caches.

highlights.title: Special Holiday Weekend Protection
highlights.description: Strict MOM compliance prevents applying special holidays on non-working Saturdays and Sundays.

highlights.title: Clear Update Status Dialogs
highlights.description: Check for updates now clearly displays dedicated Update Available and You're Up to Date dialogs.

highlights.title: Unified Typography & Clean Calendar
highlights.description: Equalized typography across all leave cards and distraction-free monthly calendar breakdown without colored leaf badges.
